overview:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: architectural interior concept, elevated cutaway overview.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the actual approved Cozy living room overview. Input image 2 is a STYLE reference only.
Primary request: Create the same room with ONE connected L-shaped sectional sofa instead of the existing straight sofa and the right-hand olive armchair. This is a furniture layout variant, not a new room.
Sofa: generously cushioned, low, softly rounded modular L sofa in warm oatmeal/ivory textured linen-wool, matching the cozy reference. Main run remains parallel to the glazed front facade with its back towards the windows and seating facing the movie projection on the rear wall. The connected perpendicular return is on the RIGHT side as viewed in this image, extending AWAY from the camera toward the screen, beside the right wall. It has a low padded outer side back and inward-facing seats, visibly a real corner L sectional, not a freestanding ottoman. Proposed overall footprint about 2.9m across x 2.05m deep in a room 5.64m wide x 5.015m deep. Keep the sectional modestly sized and leave about 1.15m behind it to the facade. Only the right end extends forward.
Remove the right olive armchair entirely; retain ONE olive armchair toward the rear-left edge of the seating group. Move the round pale stone coffee table slightly left into the inner space of the L, approx 75cm diameter. Keep the sofa's front left side visually open.
Right-wall bookshelf: keep a warm timber illuminated bookshelf, but concentrate it into TWO narrower full-height bays toward the far rear end of the right wall so the end of the L does not block the shelves. No shelving directly behind the L return. Keep arched niche shelving unchanged.
Invariants: preserve exactly the same room shell and camera angle, facade balcony glazing and separate small window/radiator grille, rear doorway, left wall opening, arch niche, parquet floor, cream rug, projection rectangle and low media console, plant locations, curtains, calm warm evening lighting. Keep the entire left-hand circulation strip and balcony access open. Keep same warm oak/walnut, olive, ivory and terracotta palette. Do not add a fireplace, beams, doors, windows, extra chairs, text or labels.
High quality realistic architectural visualization. Wide landscape image with the full room visible.

Make the L shape clearly visible from this view. No extra chairs, no U sofa, no ottoman replacing the connected L, no fireplace or beams, no text or labels. Photorealistic interior concept, landscape.
